crossRefs.note: and laid hands on the apostles, then put them in public custody.

translations.web: One came and told them, “Behold, the men whom you put in prison are in the temple, standing and teaching the people.”
translations.bsb: Then someone came in and announced, “Look, the men you put in jail are standing in the temple courts teaching the people!”
translations.kjv: Then came one and told them, saying, Behold, the men whom ye put in prison are standing in the temple, and teaching the people.
translations.asv: And there came one and told them, Behold, the men whom ye put in the prison are in the temple standing and teaching the people.
